summary: Iteration 68 verified the DM + Profile bug-fix bundle (read receipts, typing, group-avatar fallback, Messages full-screen layout, Profile default tab = Posts, Profile tab-strip horizontal-overflow fix at 430px). Backend 4/4 pytest pass. Frontend assertions pass: /profile and /user/{id} both default to Posts (data-state=active) with blogs inactive; document.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth (430==430) at mobile width; TabsList itself is horizontally scrollable (sw=454 > cw=398) so Saved is reachable and activates on click; Messages page renders full-height (innerH=bodyH=rootH=900); groups with no custom avatar render a centered group icon (visually confirmed in /messages screenshot). No LLM/TTS credit was spent.
critical_code_review_comments: Messages.jsx conversation rows navigate via onClick (likely useNavigate) instead of using <a href>. This made the testing agent unable to open a chat via url navigation. Consider wrapping each row in a <Link to="/messages/:id"> so the DOM has crawlable hrefs — improves accessibility, right-click 'open in new tab', AND makes automated testing simpler.

The polling / mutation-based flicker fix in ChatPane is a reasonable pragmatic solution, but a long-term improvement would be to subscribe to a server-sent events / WebSocket channel per conversation to push new messages and typing + read_by state (the app already has /api/rtc/ws). This would remove the periodic GET entirely and eliminate the class of 'reload every few seconds' bugs.

routes/messages.py: send_message writes `last_message.created_at` as an ISO string but conversations.updated_at is a datetime. Minor inconsistency; downstream code works because the preview tolerates both, but worth normalising.

context_for_next_testing_agent: DM read-receipt / typing / group-avatar fixes are verified end-to-end. Note that conversation rows in Messages.jsx use onClick (not <a>), so to open a specific chat in a playwright test you must click a visible row rather than page.goto(href). Backend fixture naming/filter: conversation preview returns `title` (not `name`) — filter group lookups by `title`. The pytest module test_iteration68_dm_profile.py is safe to re-run (idempotent, prefixed data).
rca of the issue: Original user bugs: (1) ChatPane re-set messages state every poll even when payload was unchanged → full re-render + scroll jump every few seconds; (2) group previews fell through to member avatars when no avatar_url was set → cropped off-center logo; (3) Profile had initialTab derived from URL/state and often resolved to 'blogs'; (4) TabsList used flex-wrap or min-w-0 which pushed the whole page wider than the viewport at 430px, making the entire page scroll sideways and hiding 'Saved'. Main-agent fixes verified: ChatPane now compares a message signature before setState and only auto-scrolls when near bottom; conv_preview() returns `avatar_url = ''` for groups without a custom photo (routes/messages.py L72, L84); Profile.jsx initialTab is const 'posts' and TabsList uses `overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar` with `shrink-0` triggers (confirmed sw=454, cw=398 → scroll inside the strip, page sw==iw==430). Sent/Read labels wire to the backend's per-message read_by array (verified by TestReadReceipts: peer's id appears in read_by after they GET /messages).
